classes.name: ActionApprovalLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned module that loads pending governed action approvals, re-resolves live policy and resource limits, meters committed effects, resolves competing parked work, and commits terminal approval decisions.

classes.name: ActionApprovalExecutionModule
classes.description: Deep module exposing one approval execution interface while owning live action resolution, marking and purpose reauthorization, parked-work validation, held-effect execution, and terminal lifecycle ordering.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates and authorizes approval callers, invokes the action approval execution module, maps protocol values and errors, and projects the post-commit catalog receipt.

classes.name: GovernedActionApproval
classes.description: Durable pending or terminal decision record binding the proposing actor, exact action parameters, policy scope, risk class, target, work unit, and deciding principal.

relations.name: invokes_action_approval_execution
relations.description: The gRPC transport invokes one approval execution interface after caller authorization.

relations.name: orders_action_approval_lifecycle
relations.description: The action approval execution module supplies concrete reauthorization and held-effect behavior to the durable lifecycle ordering.

relations.name: delegates_action_approval_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates approval loading and denial transitions directly to the action approval lifecycle module.

relations.name: resolves_governed_action_approval
relations.description: The action approval lifecycle module resolves a pending governed action approval to an approved or denied terminal state while preserving execution and audit ordering.

provenance.subject: delegates_action_approval_lifecycle_to
provenance.locator: approve_action load and deny_action lifecycle calls
